name: ai-security-log-analyzer
description: AI-assisted Windows security log analysis platform

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @security-log-analyzer/api && npm run build --workspace @security-log-analyzer/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @security-log-analyzer/domain && npm run build --workspace @security-log-analyzer/contracts && npm run build --workspace @security-log-analyzer/application && npm run build --workspace @security-log-analyzer/infrastructure
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @security-log-analyzer/desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npm run package --workspace @security-log-analyzer/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:build && npm run dev --workspace @security-log-analyzer/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @security-log-analyzer/api" "npm run dev --workspace @security-log-analyzer/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspace @security-log-analyzer/application && npm run test --workspace @security-log-analyzer/infrastructure && npm run test --workspace @security-log-analyzer/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @security-log-analyzer/api && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
